sections.Profile:
The "Rainbow" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on September 30, 1948, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin. ​ Notably, "Rainbow" was reissued as "Phoenix" in January 1949, featuring a different backglass but retaining the same playfield design.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1948–1949
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: America, Single Player, Dual Theme, Wood Rail, Original Theme
